$25–$50 per grant, up to about $550 per workspace

Deposit req.Inside a ChatGPT Business workspace, accept the offer in the plugin directory, install and connect the plugin, then run one real workflow within 7 days and the workspace gets $25–$50 of agentic credits. Ongoing ·PayPal is US users only; Oracle QuickStart is global; the November HubSpot and Klaviyo grants are rolled out per workspace, so you need the banner in the plugin directory to qualify SourceSource
AI toolsActual value$25–$50 per grant, up to about $550 per workspaceDeposit req.✓ Verified
What you get
OpenAI's help centre article "ChatGPT Business plugin credit promotions" explains that eligible ChatGPT Business workspaces see a promotional banner in the plugin directory on ChatGPT web or desktop. The order is: accept the offer, install and connect the plugin, then complete one real successful workflow with it within the stated window. After eligibility checks the credit is added to the workspace automatically, with no promo code and no separate application, and you and the workspace admins get a confirmation email. Current offers: PayPal pays $50 per grant, US users only, one per user and up to three users per workspace ($150 cap). Oracle QuickStart pays $50 per grant worldwide, one per user and up to five per workspace ($250 cap). The November HubSpot offer pays $25 per grant (up to two per workspace, $50 cap, 8,000 grants campaign-wide). Klaviyo pays $50 per grant (up to two per workspace, $100 cap, 10,000 grants). The four caps are counted separately, so a workspace eligible for all four could stack about $550. These are agentic credits, not API credits: they apply to workspace usage of ChatGPT Work, Codex, ChatGPT for Excel or Sheets, ChatGPT for PowerPoint and Workspace Agent. They do not change the subscription or the usage included in the plan, and November credits expire 30 days after they land. The earlier Stripe / Intuit QuickBooks / HubSpot / Gusto / Dropbox / Canva promotion ($50 each) has ended.
Conditions
You must be a member of a ChatGPT Business workspace (a paid seat, Standard, Premium or legacy Codex seats) with the plugin and its underlying apps enabled by an admin. You are not eligible if the plugin was already installed or explicitly connected when you accept the offer. November HubSpot and Klaviyo require a real successful run in ChatGPT Work or Codex in the same workspace within 7 days of accepting; PayPal and Oracle require it within 7 days of installing. Grants are first come, first served and accepting does not reserve one. PayPal is US-only.
Countries & regions

2026-11-01 → Ongoing / not announced

  1. Sign in to a Business account on ChatGPT web or the desktop app and open the plugin directory
  2. Open the plugin with the promo banner (PayPal, Oracle QuickStart, HubSpot or Klaviyo) and accept the offer first
  3. Then install and connect that plugin (an admin may need to enable it for the workspace)
  4. Run one real successful workflow with the plugin inside the window; installing alone does not count
  5. Wait for the confirmation email and check the workspace usage or billing page; spend the credit within 30 days
Official link
https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001514-chatgpt-business-plugin-credit-promotions
You need a paid Business seat to be eligible, and the credit only offsets agentic usage for 30 days, so it is not cash. Banners are rolled out per user and workspace, so not seeing one means no eligibility this round. Doing it in the wrong order (installing the plugin before accepting) disqualifies you. Supplies are limited and OpenAI can change or end an offer at any time.

Vercel's 2026-11-18 changelog made Parallel web search in fast mode free on AI Gateway through 2027-01-31, and made Parallel the default search tool for eve agents. Parallel finds relevant pages and returns links with short excerpts, filterable by site or publication date, works with any AI Gateway model and needs no separate Parallel API key. In code: pass `gateway.tools.parallelSearch({ mode: 'fast' })` in the AI SDK tools, or set `"mode": "fast"` in the `vercel:parallel_search` tool config for Chat Completions. eve needs no configuration because its default search already runs in fast mode and is free. The regular price is $5 per 1,000 requests (up to 10 results each, with extra results at $1 per 1,000). Only a mode you set in the tool configuration is free; a model choosing fast inside its own tool call does not qualify. Free capacity is shared and can be rate limited, in which case the tool call returns a rate-limit error to the model without failing the request, and it is never retried as a billed search. Free searches are not counted as billable gatewayToolCalls, but model tokens are still charged.
Conditions
Needs a Vercel account with AI Gateway enabled. Only searches with `mode: 'fast'` explicitly set in the tool configuration are free; basic, advanced and turbo modes stay at $5 per 1,000. Free capacity is shared and can be rate limited. From 2027-02-01 fast mode returns to regular pricing. Zero Data Retention is on by default; Parallel does not retain free searches or train on them.

2026-11-18 → 2027-01-31

  4. Confirm in AI Gateway logs that searches were not billed (tokens still are)

AI toolsActual value≈$10·Free (full features)Free✓ Verified
What you get
Hark is the personal AI agent Hark Labs, founded by Brett Adcock, launched on 2026-10-06, positioned as an operating system for your life: everything happens in one long-running chat, with topic threads called Projects and a customisable Home. At its centre is Handoff — every request spins up a dedicated virtual computer with its own browser, file system and terminal, which signs into millions of sites like a person, places orders, cancels subscriptions, fills forms, files expenses, books tables and makes slides. Hark says it can juggle six browsers at once; outside the browser it connects to Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 by API and can read files, query external databases and use MCP. Memory keeps your preferences and context, and Action Buttons (pay a bill or cancel in one tap), Panels (mini apps built from a sentence), Scheduled Tasks and Specialties (multi-step routines it memorises) do the rest. Pricing: the full Hark Pro feature set is free forever with no ads, limited only by a base usage cap whose size Hark has not published; Pro² at $20/mo gives 2x the usage and Pro³ at $100/mo gives 10x, with the same features in every plan. The US App Store also lists Pro⁴ ($259.99, 10x Pro², launched 2026-11-11), and its in-app prices run above the website's. Passwords and cards sit in Secured by Hark, an encrypted vault Hark itself cannot see inside, and it checks with you before payments or orders; Hark says it never sells your data or shares it with advertisers.
Conditions
The free plan needs no invite code and no card; a card is needed only to upgrade to Pro² / Pro³ or switch on auto top-up, which then charges automatically within the amount and ceiling you set. Memory is unavailable in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland. The free plan has a base usage cap whose size, cost rules and reset are not published; when you hit it you need a higher tier or a top-up to continue. Signing in, paying and ordering require your authorisation and confirmation in Hark, and Handoff relies on the accounts you connect (Gmail, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365 and so on).

  2. Connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365 and other accounts in settings so it can read mail and see your calendar
  3. Ask for what you need in Chat, e.g. "Book a table for two at 7 PM Friday and check parking nearby"; anything that needs the web goes to the Handoff cloud computer
  4. Before paying, ordering or cancelling, check the confirmation card (what it will do and what it costs) and approve it
  5. Need more usage: upgrade to Pro² ($20/mo, 2x) or Pro³ ($100/mo, 10x); the free plan keeps working without an upgrade
Official link
https://hark.com/pricing
Hark has not published the free plan's usage cap, how usage is consumed, or when it resets, so "free forever" only promises that no feature is paywalled — heavy use may hit the cap quickly (marked unverified). The ≈$10/mo in the value line is an estimate derived from Pro² at $20 for 2x the usage, not an official price. Once a card is bound or auto top-up is on, it charges when credits run low — stay unbound if you only want the free tier. The EEA, the UK and Switzerland get no Memory, so the experience differs from the US. The agent makes mistakes: check the confirmation card and the result before paying, ordering or cancelling, keep passwords and card numbers in Secured by Hark and never type them into the chat. The US App Store also has Pro⁴, and its in-app prices ($26 / $129.99 / $259.99) are higher than the website's, which is the reference.

AI toolsActual value≈$4·Free + 1 Full reset ticketFree✓ Verified
What you get
Pickle is a personal AI agent that actually does the work rather than only chatting. Two things define it. First, a cloud browser: the official help says Pickle uses a real web browser to work sites the way a person would — booking restaurants and flights, buying things, cancelling subscriptions, reading bank and brokerage records, requesting documents on government sites. That browser lives in the cloud, separate from your phone, and if a step only you can do comes up (a CAPTCHA, or you'd rather type your own password) the screen is handed to you to finish. Second, phone calls: for places with no booking page — a restaurant, a clinic's front desk, your landlord, a customer service line — Pickle calls for you, the call can be followed live, the result is reported back, and the record sits in Other chats. Before a payment or booking it shows a card of what it will do and at what price and waits for your go-ahead; if the amount rises right before paying, it asks again. Free plan (per the Japanese help centre): in Japan every account is free with no paid plan, replaced by a daily usage limit that resets to 0% at 04:00 Japan time. Replies, calls from Chat, handed-off tasks and scheduled tasks all count; conversations on 3D World calls and Pickle's own fixed routines do not. At the limit the input box turns off and scheduled tasks are skipped until 04:00. Reset tickets: a Full reset ticket returns the day's usage to 0%; a Half reset ticket lowers it by 50 points (never below 0%). You get one Full ticket for finishing onboarding, one each for you and each friend who completes sign-up through your invite link, and you can buy more in the app at prices shown on the purchase screen (the US App Store lists $3.99 for a Full ticket and $1.99 for a Half ticket; Japan about ¥600 each — it varies by store). Tickets don't expire and only restore the current day's usage; they don't raise the daily cap.
Conditions
Applies automatically to Japan/Korea accounts, with no card or subscription needed. A ticket only restores usage already spent that day and does not raise the daily cap; unused tickets stay but the day's usage resets anyway at 04:00. Once the limit is reached, new tasks can't start and scheduled tasks are skipped. The app runs on iOS and Android only (no web version).

What you get
CALL-E is a phone-call agent from AI Rudder (Singapore), launched in November 2026. It only makes outbound calls. Install the official calle skill in the AI assistant you already use (ChatGPT, Claude, Muse, OpenClaw, Hermes) or in a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), or call it through MCP, the TypeScript and Python SDKs, the REST API or WhatsApp. Say what you need and it plans the call — who to call, when, in which language, and what counts as done. It asks for anything missing, shows you the plan, and only dials after you confirm. During the call it handles live pickup, voicemail, hold, transfers, silence and interruptions, and can navigate phone menus (IVR) with keypad input. Afterwards you get a summary, the full transcript and structured data validated against a schema you define, with quoted lines as evidence and a completion-confidence label. Calls can be scheduled or sent as a batch. Typical errands: booking a table, moving an appointment, calling around for a quote, checking stock, cancelling, reaching a human in support. New accounts get 100 credits (the site says about US$1); credits are a usage allowance, not a fixed number of calls or minutes.
Conditions
100 credits once per new account. Billed per second: a US/CA outbound call in Goal mode is about $0.0148/10s model fee plus $0.02/min carrier fee (about $0.06 for 30 seconds); a one-shot call is about $0.0296/10s plus $0.04/min (about $0.13 for 30 seconds). Preparation can consume model credits even if the call never connects. Outbound only — it does not answer or screen incoming calls. International numbers outside the US/CA are mainly for development and testing; other destinations need your own SIP trunk.

New UK customers only, through the Ria app only; first transfer of £50+; the £20 only offsets the first transfer, with at most two vouchers per transfer; the £4/£6 add-ons need second and third transfers of £50+ each with the first placed before 2026-12-31, and the add-on destination list excludes the Philippines; can't be combined with other offers on the same transfer.

What you get
Skrill Money Transfer's Refer a Friend programme; the official terms state the UK line clearly: users registered in the United Kingdom, minimum transfer GBP 100 (or the equivalent in the send currency), referral credit GBP 10 for both the inviter and the new customer. The flow: the new customer registers through the inviter's link, or enters the code under "Got a referral code?" on the first transfer page (codes are valid for 3 months from registration), completes a cross-border transfer (sender and recipient in different countries, at least £100 excluding fees and taxes, delivered successfully), and once the recipient's funds are confirmed Skrill places £10 of credit under My Account → Refer a Friend, usable on the next qualifying transfer within 3 months, up to £50 per transfer (at most 5 credits). Registration and KYC need an ID plus proof of address (a passport plus UK proof of address is enough, with 4 days to supply it before the transaction is cancelled). Payment must be a UK-issued debit or credit card or a UK bank account — Skrill balance can't be used. The same account can apply for the Skrill Prepaid Mastercard: UK and EEA residents qualify, the virtual card works as soon as it's approved, the physical card arrives within 15 working days and it's denominated in euros. A UK user's hands-on report: paying with a UK card, transfers to Germany, the US, Italy and the Philippines arrived almost instantly, all done on the website (ordering in the app doesn't get this offer).

On 17 November Mistral AI released limited free 3-month Vibe Pro places to European developers to mark the launch of the open model Le Chonk (Mistral Large 4, 1 trillion parameters with about 52 billion active) combined with Vibe, using code LECHONK. Vibe Pro normally costs $14.99/mo before tax, so three months saves about $45 and includes higher message and web-search limits, expanded Vibe capacity, all-day CLI/IDE/web agentic coding and a monthly API allowance. Places ran out that day and Mistral said on X that more might come the next day; on 11-18 the community saw the code go from "unavailable" back to claimable after a restock, so it's issued in batches. Re-check (2026-11-20 03:30): Mistral restocked once on 11-18 alongside the Vibe Desktop launch, but users again reported "This code is no longer available" the same day. From 11-19, AI Promo Now marks it "verified: no longer works" and mydealz lists it as ended, while users on X are still asking @MistralAI for another drop. It is archived as sold out; if codes return, it can be revived.
Conditions
European developers only; limited places, first come first served, and the code shows "This code is no longer available" until restocked; redeem while signed in to a Mistral account; a valid payment method is needed and community reports say zero-balance virtual cards usually pass verification (a data point, not an official promise); it renews at $14.99/mo, so cancel manually.

  3. Confirm Vibe Pro is $0 for the first 3 months and submit
  4. Cancel the renewal on the subscription page before it ends
